# Jonathan Orlowski

> MLOps-oriented software engineer with 10+ years in business intelligence. Builds and deploys ML, full-stack and IoT projects, all self-hosted on one VPS with Docker, Caddy, Postgres and Prometheus/Grafana monitoring.

Born in Argentina, based between London and Kampala. Email is the best way to get in touch: jonorl@gmail.com.

## Original projects

- [Where in the World? (Carmen Sandiego remake)](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/carmen): the 1990 detective game remade in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly, with family and friends as the thieves, in English or Spanish. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/carmen
- [Air Quality Monitor (IoT)](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/pollution/): Rust firmware on an ESP32-S3 posts particle readings to a Fastify/Prisma API; a React + three.js dashboard draws them live. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/pollution
- [Teatro Dislocador](https://teatrodislocador.ar): live site for an independent theatre in Comodoro Rivadavia, Argentina, with a public site, an admin CMS and a Postgres/Prisma API. Source: https://github.com/jonorl/teatro-dislocador

## AI/ML projects

- [Agentic AI Workflow](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/agentic-ai-news-to-image/): picks a news headline, checks it against recent memory and generates an image for it with n8n, Gemini, Llama and Flux.
- [Voice Clone](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/voice-clone/): Argentine Spanish voice clone, fine-tuned from XTTS v2 on local hardware.
- [Mini-LLM Text Generator](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/simpsons-gpt/): GPT-2 mini trained on Simpsons scripts.
- [Image Classification](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/fugazzeta/): pizza classifier built on convnext_tiny with fastai.

## Other full-stack projects

- [OdinBook](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/odin-book/): social media site with guest, Google and GitHub logins.
- [Messaging App](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/messaging-app/): real-time messaging with JWT auth and image attachments.
- [Where's Bluey](https://jonathan-orlowski.dev/game/): Where's Wally-style children's game with a server-side timer and leaderboard.
